findings.message: <div id="hook"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="hook"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: en-landscape.html, en-portrait.html, he-landscape.html, he-portrait.html, index.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.
